svg.title: AGV assignment
svg.desc: Costs per AGV and tray move, then a bottleneck matching.
svg.metadata: ["For each AGV and each tray move that can start now, a cost: the time to reach the tray and lift it (illustrative values).", "Bottleneck matching keeps the largest chosen cost as small as possible: AGV-1 takes tray T15 (14 s), AGV-2 takes tray T27 (6 s). AGV-1 then continues with job A's next tray moves."]
